display_name: 兔子镜小剧场 / Rabbit Mirror Theater（TEST・生成方式切换・维修兔 v2.07-test）
author: Toto
description: RabbitMirror test build. Independent API generation waits for the regenerated visible answer source to remain stable before launching, preventing a reasoning-pass mirror followed by a second mirror. Maintenance Rabbit stores a pre-repair DOM snapshot and can restore the current mirror to its interface before interaction repair. No fixed prompt is added to the current API in independent mode.
